change: Transfer E024's plain 2D U-Net, CE+Dice loss, and safe no-elastic augmentation to the full course-labelled HU-wide dataset. The run has a 150-epoch maximum and validation-Dice early stopping after 20 non-improving epochs.
hypothesis: The E024 recipe will improve on E_F01's HU-wide ENet/CE/no-augmentation baseline when trained on the larger native four-organ dataset.
plan_reference: Full-dataset transfer of E024; composite recipe comparison against E_F01, not an architecture-only ablation.

dataset.name: SEGTHOR_FULL_huwide
dataset.label_caveat: Native course-provided four-organ labels; unlike E017-E024, no aorta recovery is used.

wandb.data_policy: Scalar metrics and the YAML configuration only; no images, masks, predictions, checkpoints, or source code.

what_to_check: The GPU preflight must initialize CEDiceLoss and execute one augmented U-Net batch on SEGTHOR_FULL_huwide.
Record the actual completed epoch count and the best validation-Dice epoch; 150 is a maximum, not a guaranteed duration.
Compare 3D metrics with E_F01_hu_wide, noting that this is a composite recipe transfer rather than an architecture-only comparison.
Report U-Net parameter count and GPU training time alongside accuracy.
